title: stellaria uliginosa var. undulata
intro: Stellaria uliginosa var. undulata, commonly known as Marsh Starwort, is a perennial herb that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Starwort include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Marsh Starwort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
